Title: Project scaffolding
Description: Initialize the loadtest CLI project under `loadtest/`. Create `package.json` (with `bin` entry pointing to `dist/cli.js`), `tsconfig.json`, `.gitignore`, and install dependencies: `undici`, `commander`, `zod`, `cli-table3`, `ora`, `chalk`. Also install dev deps: `typescript`, `vitest`, `@types/node`. Add npm scripts: `build`, `dev`, `test`, `lint`.

Title: Config types and validation
Description: Create `src/config.ts`. Define and export a Zod schema (`RunConfigSchema`) covering: `url` (URL string), `method` (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH, default GET), `headers` (Record<string,string>), `body` (optional string), `vus` (number, default 10), `duration` (string like '30s'/'1m', parsed to ms), `scenario` (constant|rampup|spike, default constant), `rampDuration` (optional), `maxVus` (optional), `spikeDuration` (optional), `output` (terminal|json|csv, default terminal), `timeout` (default 30s). Export the inferred `RunConfig` TypeScript type and a `parseConfig` helper.

Title: HTTP request engine
Description: Create `src/engine.ts`. Implement a `RequestEngine` class backed by `undici`'s `Pool` for connection reuse. Expose an `async fire(config: RunConfig): Promise<RequestResult>` method that measures wall-clock latency (using `performance.now()`), captures status code, and catches network errors. The `RequestResult` type should include: `latencyMs: number`, `statusCode: number | null`, `error: string | null`, `timestamp: number`. Export the class and type.

Title: Metrics collector
Description: Create `src/metrics.ts`. Implement a `MetricsCollector` class with: `record(result: RequestResult): void` to ingest each result, `snapshot(): MetricsSummary` to compute aggregates (total/success/fail counts, RPS, latency percentiles p50/p90/p95/p99/max/mean/min using a sorted-array approach), and `timeSeries(): TimeSeriesPoint[]` returning per-second buckets for CSV export. Export types `MetricsSummary` and `TimeSeriesPoint`.

Title: Constant load scenario
Description: Create `src/scenarios/constant.ts`. Implement `runConstant(config: RunConfig, engine: RequestEngine, collector: MetricsCollector, onTick?: (summary: MetricsSummary) => void): Promise<MetricsSummary>`. Spawn exactly `config.vus` concurrent workers, each looping `engine.fire()` → `collector.record()` until the elapsed duration is reached. Call `onTick` once per second with a live snapshot. Return the final summary.

Title: Ramp-up and spike scenarios
Description: Create `src/scenarios/rampup.ts` and `src/scenarios/spike.ts`. Ramp-up: linearly increase active VUs from 0 to `maxVus` over `rampDuration`, then hold at `maxVus` until total duration ends; manage a worker pool that grows over time. Spike: hold `vus` baseline workers, at the midpoint instantly spawn `maxVus` workers for `spikeDuration`, then drop back to baseline. Both share the same `onTick` callback and return `MetricsSummary`. Export a `runScenario(config, engine, collector, onTick)` dispatcher in `src/scenarios/index.ts`.

Title: Terminal reporter
Description: Create `src/reporter.ts`. Implement: (1) `LiveReporter` — uses `ora` spinner updated each tick to show elapsed time, current RPS, and VU count; (2) `printSummary(summary: MetricsSummary)` — renders a color-coded `cli-table3` table with all metrics; (3) `exportJson(summary: MetricsSummary): string` — returns a formatted JSON string; (4) `exportCsv(points: TimeSeriesPoint[]): string` — returns a CSV string with headers `timestamp,rps,p50,p99,errors`. Wire output format selection based on `config.output`.

Title: CLI entry point
Description: Create `src/cli.ts` and `src/index.ts`. In `cli.ts`: use `commander` to define a `run` subcommand with all options matching `RunConfigSchema` fields (`--url`, `--method`, `--vus`, `--duration`, `--scenario`, `--ramp-duration`, `--max-vus`, `--spike-duration`, `--header` (repeatable), `--body`, `--output`, `--timeout`). Parse and validate with `parseConfig`, instantiate `RequestEngine`, `MetricsCollector`, `LiveReporter`, call `runScenario`, then render final output per `config.output`. Handle errors with a user-friendly message and non-zero exit code. Add `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang.

Title: Unit tests
Description: Create `tests/metrics.test.ts`, `tests/engine.test.ts`, and `tests/scenarios.test.ts` using `vitest`. Metrics tests: verify percentile calculations, RPS computation, and time-series bucketing with known inputs. Engine tests: mock `undici` to verify latency capture, error handling, and status code recording. Scenario tests: mock engine to verify constant/rampup VU counts over time and that the collector receives the expected number of records. Aim for >80% coverage on core modules.

Title: README and documentation
Description: Create `loadtest/README.md` covering: project overview, installation (`npm install -g` or `npx`), all CLI flags with descriptions and defaults, example commands (basic GET, POST with auth header, rampup scenario, JSON export), sample terminal output, output format explanations, and contributing notes. Update the root `/repo/README.md` to mention the loadtest CLI under a new 'Tools' section.
